Orthopedic Surgeon & Joint Replacement Hospital in Ahmedabad

At Silver Touch Hospitals, we understand how chronic joint pain can change your life. Simple joys like walking in a park, climbing stairs, or even playing with your grandchildren can become difficult. If you are struggling with persistent knee pain that hasn’t responded to medicine or therapy, we are here to help you regain your mobility and comfort.

As a leading orthopedic hospital in Ahmedabad, we focus on providing care that is easy to understand and even easier to access. Our goal is to help you walk pain-free again.

What is Knee Replacement Surgery?

Knee replacement surgery is a procedure where a damaged or worn-out knee joint is replaced with an artificial one. Think of it like “resurfacing” the joint. When the cartilage that cushions your bones wears away, the bones rub against each other, causing severe pain and stiffness. During the surgery, our surgeons remove the damaged surface and cap the ends of the bones with high-quality metal and plastic parts. This allows the joint to move smoothly without the friction that causes you pain.

Types of Knee Replacement Surgeries

Every patient is unique, and so is their knee condition. At Silver Touch, we offer different types of surgeries based on how much of your knee is damaged:

  • Total Knee Replacement (TKR): This is the most common version. The entire joint surface is replaced.
  • Partial Knee Replacement: If only one side of your knee is affected by wear and tear, we only replace that specific part, keeping your healthy bone and ligaments intact.
  • Complex or Revision Surgery: This is for patients who may have had a previous surgery that needs correction or have very severe bone loss.
  • Robotic Knee Replacement: For patients who want the most advanced option, we also offer robotic-assisted knee replacement.

When is Knee Replacement Surgery Recommended?

We usually suggest surgery as a “last resort” when other treatments like physical therapy, injections, or medications no longer provide relief. You might be a candidate if:

  • Your knee pain limits everyday activities like walking or bending.
  • The pain continues even while you are resting or trying to sleep at night.
  • You have chronic knee inflammation and swelling that doesn’t improve with rest.
  • Your knee has a visible deformity, such as bowing in or out.

Pediatric Orthopedic Care

Our orthopedic team also cares for children with bone, joint, and growth-related concerns. From fractures to developmental issues, we create a comfortable, child-friendly experience for young patients and their families.

Preparation for Knee Replacement Surgery

Preparation is the key to a smooth recovery. Before the procedure, our team will guide you through a complete health check-up. We might suggest some simple strengthening exercises for your legs to help with post-surgery movement. We also recommend making small changes at home, like installing a shower chair or clearing up loose rugs, to make your movement safer when you return from the hospital.

Procedure for Knee Replacement Surgery at Silver Touch Hospitals

When you visit us, you are in the hands of an experienced orthopedic surgeon in Ahmedabad. On the day of the surgery, you will be given anesthesia so you won’t feel any pain. The surgeon makes an incision to access the knee, removes the damaged bone and cartilage, and precisely fits the new artificial joint. We use advanced tools to ensure the alignment is perfect, which is crucial for the long life of the implant. The entire process usually takes about one to two hours.

Recovery After Knee Replacement Surgery

Recovery starts almost immediately. Most of our patients are encouraged to stand and take a few steps with help within 24 hours of surgery.

  1. In the Hospital: You will stay with us for a few days while our physiotherapists help you start moving your new knee.
  2. At Home: You will continue a set of exercises designed to improve your range of motion.
  3. Long-term: Most people can return to light daily activities within 3 to 6 weeks. Following your exercise routine is the most important part of getting back to normal.

Affordable Joint Replacement Care

We believe quality joint replacement shouldn’t be out of reach. Our team works with you on transparent pricing and supports insurance and cashless treatment options, so you can focus on recovery, not costs.

Benefits of Total Knee Replacement

Choosing to undergo surgery at a dedicated total knee replacement hospital in Ahmedabad offers life-changing benefits:

  • Pain Relief: The primary benefit is the significant reduction or total elimination of chronic pain.
  • Improved Mobility: You will find it much easier to walk, climb stairs, and get in and out of chairs.
  • Better Quality of Life: You can return to hobbies and social activities that you had to give up because of your knee.

Why Choose Silver Touch Hospital for Knee Replacement Surgery in Ahmedabad?

We pride ourselves on being the best joint replacement hospital in Ahmedabad by combining medical expertise with a personal touch. Our facility is equipped with the latest technology, and our staff is trained to support you at every step, from the first consultation to the final physiotherapy session.

Our orthopedics department is specifically designed for patient comfort and successful outcomes. When you choose us, your case is handled by a joint replacement surgeon in Ahmedabad who prioritizes your safety and long-term health.

If you are looking for a reliable knee replacement hospital in Ahmedabad, we invite you to schedule a consultation with us. Let us help you take that first step toward a more active, pain-free life.

Contact Us, Today!

Schedule a consultation today with one of Ahmedabad’s top joint replacement surgeons and get back to living life free from joint pain. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we enable you to walk freely again — confidently, comfortably, and with care.
